visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with glasses, wearing a beige t-shirt and black trousers, walks briskly on a sidewalk past a shop entrance. A woman in a striped shirt and denim overalls stands beside a promotional banner featuring food images and 'Bon Box' branding. The lighting is natural daylight. (2) The man performs an exaggerated stumbling motion toward the camera. The scene cuts to a fast-paced montage of him moving through a covered urban corridor with white pillars and parked scooters. Digital blur effects are applied to simulate high-speed movement. (3) The man suddenly appears seated on a grey chair at a light wood table inside a modern restaurant. He holds a wooden tray containing a meal box with purple rice, sliced chicken breast, broccoli, and a soft-boiled egg. He uses wooden chopsticks to eat a piece of chicken. (4) He looks directly at the camera, talking expressively while holding the meal tray. Behind him, a wall features a green sign with '乐坡 BON BOX' text. Yellow subtitles and variety-style text overlays appear at the bottom and top of the frame.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 散步散步. (2) [Variety]: 哎呀. (3) [Slogan]: BON BOX. (4) [Subtitle]: 我餓啦我餓啦我餓啦. (5) [Subtitle]: 哇 真香. (6) [Subtitle]: 即日起到4月30號. (7) [Subtitle]: 在全台的Bon Box都能吃到吃完啦蒜香辣椒醬的聯名餐點. (8) [Subtitle]: 還沒吃過的朋友趕快去試看看吧. (9) [Variety]: 吃完 “辣” 雞胸便當.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main male creator, 1 female standing in the background.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young male with black hair, wearing black-rimmed glasses, a plain beige oversized t-shirt, and black athletic pants.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video starts on an urban sidewalk with tiled flooring and shopfronts. It then transitions through a white-pillared corridor/walkway and ends inside a clean, brightly lit modern restaurant with wooden furniture and brand signage.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice says 'Sanbu sanbu' in a relaxed, mid-pitch tone. A faint background hum of a city street is present. No music is playing. (2) A sharp, high-pitched vocal yell 'Ai ya!' occurs. Simultaneously, a synthesized 'whoosh' transition effect and a percussive impact SFX are triggered to match the stumbling movement. (3) An upbeat, electronic dance music track with a driving 4/4 beat and bright synth stabs begins. The male speaker repeats 'Wo e la' (I'm hungry) rapidly with high energy. Percussive 'thud' sounds sync with his visual landing. (4) The speaker transitions into a clear, professional narrative tone, recommending the meal. The music continues at a steady volume underneath. A 'ding' bell sound effect is used to highlight specific promotional text appearing on screen. The audio remains clean with high vocal clarity until the end.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Transition -> Content Showcase -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous, high-energy 'teleportation' hook to grab attention before pivoting into a promotional review of a collaborative meal box at Bon Box restaurant. It aims to drive sales by showcasing the food's appearance and providing specific dates and locations for the promotion.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator specifically mentions the brand 'Bon Box', shows the logo, names a specific meal, and provides promotion dates and locations.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-production-value short-form ad using social media editing trends (fast cuts, variety text) to make promotional content engaging.
